summary: Accepted thin system binding implemented. Static inspection: actual Console redirection/Environment.UserInteractive; default source private adapter; Console.ReadKey uses supplied intercept only after KeyAvailable with cancellation before/after; cancellable Task.Delay waiting, no Task.Run/abandoned blocking read. Shared default-source semaphore serializes full entry across instances under exclusive application console-reader assumption. Injected terminal admission per source instance. Write receives only fixed prompts/separators; no handle ownership/stream close. This is static adapter verification plus controlled regressions, explicitly not native-terminal runtime evidence.
final_shape: Production owner assessed cohesive shared entry algorithm/thin binding; no further local refactor required. Configuration/current-session/current-authority obligations and delivery gates remain open.
